summary: Gilat Satellite Networks filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a multimillion-dollar strategic partnership with Nelco in India to deploy the SkyEdge IV platform. The release reports an order from Nelco, with deliveries expected over 12 months, but provides no specific financial terms, stake, price per share, premium, or board recommendation. This is a routine business development announcement, not a special situation transaction. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or liquidity event. No deal mechanics or structural notes are present. There is no regulatory clock or risk-arb angle.
